subject: Tamil woman in a deep maroon and indigo Kanchipuram silk sari with gold zari border, jasmine flowers in her hair, carefully drawing a white rice-flour pulli kolam; a brass bowl of rice flour nearby

setting.place: An interior courtyard of a Chettinad heritage house in Karaikudi, Sivaganga district, Tamil Nadu
setting.era: Present-day Margazhi season in a house with early-20th-century Chettinad architecture
setting.architecture: carved wooden pillars, Athangudi patterned tiles, timber beams, shaded thinnai and traditional brass lamps

lighting: cool soft blue dawn light blending with warm brass-lamp glow; realistic shadows

camera.angle: eye-level three-quarter view across the courtyard

style: photorealistic cinematic documentary photograph, culturally specific, natural facial features and textiles, credible domestic scene

motion.subject_motion: The woman and kolam remain almost still, preserving the base still image; no synthetic limb animation
motion.camera_move: slow continuous digital dolly-in (Ken Burns zoom), steady camera, no cuts
